head: name: agent-lang
description: >-
Symbolic inter-agent language for Rust_engine_template_01 — BLANG build loops,
$ref file/symbol schematization, emoji status dimensions, DSM AUTH spine,
4D tensor projection T[c,d,a,φ], and stream delimiters for token minimization
across agent/human/subagent handoffs. Use at session start, HANDOFF reads,
witness routing, and when context drift threatens path/symbol coherence.
disable-model-invocation: true
# AGENT-LANG — symbolic inter-agent communication
**Normative spec:** `$ref:src/dev/agent_lang_v1.md`
**v3Ω meta field:** `$ref:docs/archive/2026-06-src-dev/plans/agent_meta_brief_v3.md` · `$ref:docs/archive/2026-06-src-dev/plans/agent_meta_field_registry_v3.md`
**Fold atlas:** `$ref:docs/archive/2026-06-src-dev/plans/agent_meta_diagrams_v3_fold.md`
**Grammar lattice:** `$ref:docs/archive/2026-06-src-dev/plans/agent_meta_grammar_v3_lattice.md` — **STATE · FLOW · REVIEW clusters**
**Program:** `$ref:docs/archive/2026-06-src-dev/plans/plan_mcp_agent_lang_program_v1.md`
**4D board:** `$ref:src/dev/master_chain_board_4d_v1.md` · `$ref:tools/orchestrator/queues/master_chain_tensor_v1.json`
> Agents compress **status, routing, refs, and build loops** — not prose paths.
## When to use
- Session start / slice pick / handoff between human ↔ agent ↔ subagent
- Any `$ref:` path in orders, HANDOFF, queue `note`
- Context drift — re-anchor with symbol + file, not chat memory
- Token stream interrupt / continue across model turns
- OPS routing, DSM closure, complexity budget paste blocks
## Session loop (canonical)
```text
BLANG:STATS → BLANG:BOOT → BLANG:ROLE → BLANG:PRE → BLANG:Q+ → work → BLANG:WIT → BLANG:Q✓ → BLANG:RUN
**Bootstrap fragment:** `$ref:.cursor/agents/_fragments/session_bootstrap_v1.md` — all `.cursor/agents/*.md` mandate this chain.
| BLANG | MCP / CLI |
| `BLANG:STATS` | `agent_doc_reads_brief(min_reads=2)` |
| `BLANG:BOOT` | `agent_session_bootstrap(agent)` — **includes `prompts/llm_agent_brief.md` §FIELD◈** |
| `BLANG:ROLE` | `agent_doc_touch(path, intent="ref")` per agent matrix |
| `BLANG:CACHE` | `agent_doc_digest_cached(path)` |
| `BLANG:PROMOTE` | `agent_doc_promote_hot_reads()` — repeated paths → MCP cache |
| `BLANG:PRE` | `pipeline_preflight()` |
| `BLANG:Q+` | `agent_queue_next(agent)` |
| `BLANG:Q✓` | `agent_queue_update(id, status, note)` |
| `BLANG:HO` | `handoff_brief()` |
| `BLANG:WIT` | `witness_brief(path)` |
| `BLANG:DIGEST` | `snapshot_digest(path)` |
| `BLANG:P0` | `validate_p0_gate_plain(path)` |
| `BLANG:CARGO` | `validate_cargo_report(compress=4, use_cached=true)` |
| `BLANG:BEVY` | `validate_bevy_report(compress=4)` |
| `BLANG:REF` | `agent_doc_touch(path, intent="ref")` |
| `BLANG:RUN` | `agent_run_append({slice_id, tools_called})` |
| `BLANG:MARK` | `agent_marker_append(...)` |
| `BLANG:MIRROR` | `agent_markers_brief(tail=8)` |
**Policy:** `token_savings_guide()` — CLI `token-savings-guide` or MCP `token_savings_guide`.
## Symbolic breakpoints (forced continuation)
When idle/blocked — **never wait-only**:
```text
⟨BP:COLLECT⟩ → ⟨BP:MIRROR⟩ → ⟨BP:SCAN⟩ → ⟨BP:SHARE⟩ → ⟨BP:RESUME⟩
Normative: `$ref:docs/archive/2026-06-src-dev/plans/agent_collective_ritual_v1.md`
## Response networking (3-layer paste)
```text
T[c,d,a,φ]  🔗  $sym:Writer@path  🔗  marker.mirror one line
## AUTH spine (DSM)
```text
AUTH: MAT★ ⇢ APS★ ⇢ SNAP★ ⇢ WRK○ ⇢ ATL○ ⇢ RT○
| Sym | Meaning |
| `★` | Closed / witness green |
| `○` | Open |
| `○→★` | Closed this session |
| `⇢` | Flow |
| `↺` | Loop / retry |
## Slice & route
| Sym | Example | Meaning |
| `⟨ID⟩` | `⟨GRAMMAR-ITER-001-API⟩` | Queue / program row |
| `@agent` | `@coder-mcp` | Role |
| `ΔWF→@agent` | `ΔWF→@coder G2S-2` | Route next |
| `⏸` | `⏸ WH-TRACK-B` | Paused — non-blocking |
| `⚡P0` | `⚡P0 plain P0 gate` | Do first |
## Status dimensions (max 3 emoji per section)
| Sym | Use |
| 🟢 | Green witness / gate pass |
| 🟡 | Qualified / pass with notes |
| 🔴 | Blocked |
| 🧊 | Explicit defer |
| 🧩 | Dependency |
| 🔗 | Cross-ref only |
| 💬 | Human / operator gate |
## File refs — `$ref` (drift-resistant schematization)
```text
$ref:<repo-relative-path>[§<section-slug>]
$sym:<RustSymbol>@<path>   # e.g. $sym:ViewAuthoritySystemSet@src/gui/view_authority.rs
